source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN]
            WHERE H = 'D'
				AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE);


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[ACID]
				,CC.[B2K_TYPE]
				,CC.[B2K_ID]
				,CC.[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,CC.[DEL_FLG]
				,CC.[LIEN_AMT]
				,CC.[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,CC.[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[LCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,CC.[RCRE_TIME]
				,CC.[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,CC.[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,CC.[TS_CNT]
				,CC.[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,CC.[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,CC.[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,CC.[CONTACT_NUM]
				,CC.[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,CC.[SOL_ID]
				,CC.[USER_ID]
				,CC.[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,CC.[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,CC.[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN B 
			ON CC.ACID = B.ACID
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			AND CC.B2K_ID = B.B2K_ID
            AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(B.FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(B.RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.ACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.B2K_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.B2K_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

SELECT
				 [ACID]
				,[B2K_TYPE]
				,[B2K_ID]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[LIEN_AMT]
				,[LIEN_REMARKS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[LIEN_REASON_CODE]
				,[LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[ALT_CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[LIEN_START_DATE]
				,[REQUESTED_BY_DESC]
				,[REQUEST_DEPARTMENT]
				,[CONTACT_NUM]
				,[FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT]
				,[SOL_ID]
				,[USER_ID]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_REF_NUM]
				,[LIEN_EVENT_MISC_INFO]
				,[LIEN_TIME_ZONE]
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'DEP'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
